Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sonali - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 40 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The fishermen's village - Day

[Aditya stands in the village. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Sonali: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Vikram stand near him.]

Aditya: "Dad, look over here."

[Aditya hugs Mother tightly.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya stamps his foot in anger.]

Aditya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya helps Mother get up.]

Sonali: "Let's see."

[Snow begins to fall.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Sonali and Vikram stand near him.]

Sonali: "Vikram, look over here."

[Aditya knocks on the door.]

Vikram (softly): "Okay, Aditya."

[Aditya opens the door and goes out.]

Sonali: "What happened?"

[Aditya slams the door shut.]

Vikram: "That was such a fun day!"
